description: Defines classes and methods for PRACH detection, including a generic implementation and a parameter validator, with external dependencies on DFT processing and PRACH sequence generation.

classes.name: prach_detector_validator_impl
classes.description: Implements validation for PRACH detector parameters.

classes.name: prach_detector_generic_impl

methods.name: vector_noise_estimation
